thread:
incidentbot: PagerDuty — Alert fired for service `inference-prod` (high latency, region: eu-west-1). Trigger: p95 inference latency > 1200ms. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-12345
vikram: acked the page, I'm on it. pulling recent dashboards.
alex: thanks, saar. any immediate customer impact?
vikram: p95 is spiking for a subset of requests routed to eu-west-1, looks like queue depth on GPU pool increased. frontend 503s ~3% for a few customers.
maria: copying customer success: CSI reported slow responses for batch-embed jobs.
incidentbot: PagerDuty — Secondary escalation scheduled in 5m (no ack from secondary). Escalation policy: inference-prod -> secondary -> manager.
vikram: starting rolling restart of affected worker pool (kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-worker -n prod). will tail logs.
oncall-sre: +1 to restarts, but watch KV cache warmup times.
ops-manager: if secondary escalates, be ready to open bridge. Noted potential customer impact.
incidentbot: PagerDuty — Secondary escalated (no ack). Manager escalation in 2m.
alex: noticed an increase in token generation latencies after last autoscaling round. might be a throttling issue with our autoscaler.
vikram: logs show repeated OOMKill on pod inference-worker-7cf9. attaching snippet: ```OOMKilled: container_memory_fail```
maria: rolling rollback to previous image? last deploy was 02:12 UTC, could be regression.
vikram: rolling back would take ~5m; restart is faster. I'm restarting only nodes hitting OOMs.
oncall-sre: pushed a temporary route to route ~20% traffic to us-west-2 variant to protect customers: `traffic-split: inference-prod: eu-west-1 80% -> us-west-2 20%`
alex: good, that drops customer errors to ~1.2% now.
incidentbot: PagerDuty — Manager escalated (ops-manager acknowledged).
ops-manager: joining. what's our ETA to stable at p95 < 400ms?
vikram: after restarts + reduced traffic, p95 trending down, ETA ~8-10m.
maria: opening a short status page post explaining degraded performance and mitigation. will coordinate messaging with CS.
ops-manager: assign follow-ups: 1) root cause (OOM regression) 2) autoscaler config review 3) run replay on canary.
vikram: taking RCA. prelim note: memory growth in kv-cache manager after last runtime change.
oncall-sre: monitoring: no new 503s for the last 4m, error budget usage stabilized.
alex: confirming no data loss, just latency. CS reached out to two affected customers, shared mitigation steps.
incidentbot: PagerDuty — Alert RESOLVED (inference-prod).
ops-manager: nice work. please add timeline and mitigation steps to the incident ticket.
maria: will draft customer msg and post on status page.
vikram: will collect heap dumps and open PR for cache cap.
oncall-sre: leaving follow-up playbook in #eng-oncall.
alex: tl;dr: autoscaler + kv-cache regression caused OOMs -> p95 spike; mitigated by restart + partial traffic reroute; manager escalated once secondary didn't ack.
maria: closing thread after status page is live. :white_check_mark:
